base_protocol.bin_semantics: source bin [bin_start,endpoint); endpoint is bin end; endpoints in (window_end-W,window_end]; window_end=decision_tick-2min; available_at=endpoint+delay; first changed bin_start=event.start
base_protocol.sr_score: maximum over valid features of abs(X[j]-train_median[j]) / max(train_q90[j]-train_q10[j],0.05), train statistics use valid rows; validity bits excluded; no empirical-CDF-only proxy
base_protocol.calibration_policy: Allocated branch budget: one envelope cut per branch/seed from normal calibration only; all group x C1/5/15 guards simultaneously. Fixed quantile grid union maximum per-group/C higher quantile at 1-allocated-positive-time-budget, at most8; cut>=this floor; strict score>cut; evaluate bounded candidates in order and take first passing candidate; no later recalibration. Standalone fraction1, family-only each1/3, joint SR families each1/6 and ML1/2. Actual ternary-OR union must additionally pass the full original normal budget.
base_protocol.suite: A:60 intended events per evaluation split, predetermined source_unknown/late/unseen-category crosses retained in denominator
base_protocol.primary_event_metric: new episode onset in [actual event.start,event.end), one-to-one; confirmed_start only marks early subset, early is included in actual-onset primary
base_protocol.cadence_policy: One-minute causal feature trace with unchanged 2min watermark and common720min source/category readiness. Primary holdout C5; predeclared secondary descriptive C1; C15 is calibration guard only. Same frozen reference/model/cut/input/raw/pred at common ticks. No cadence-based holdout reselection or recalibration.
base_protocol.selection_policy: No holdout selection: all ten predeclared arms at common W1/C5; normal calibration eligibility is frozen before main blind opens.
base_protocol.scope_limit: Independent controlled synthetic follow-up to earlier diagnosed benchmark; all W1; new seeds/dates; no production/model/DB changes; improvement and actual business validity must be evaluated separately

fixture.purpose: isolated integration only; no performance claim or selection

feature_contract.relation_ready: common source/category ready AND both relation feature validity bits true; otherwise not_ready, never zero score
feature_contract.family_ready: at least one valid physical feature in family; relation additionally requires both relation validity bits
feature_contract.score_excludes: family SR excludes clock3 and neutral3; old_sr retains legacy40 active candidates; full43 forests retain original43 numeric values
feature_contract.view_comparison: full43 uses original common train cohort and own train-only encoder; relation2 uses both-valid-only train cohort and own train-only encoder; this is a package comparison, not a pure dimensionality ablation
feature_contract.train_sampling: common sourceeligible & train_mask C5 indices, deterministic seed cap4096 first; full43 uses all sampled finite rows, relation2 uses both-valid subset of these rows and its own encoder; store row counts/ticks/hash per view

score_contract.old_sr: max over legacy SR active valid features abs(X-train_median)/max(train_q90-train_q10,0.05)
score_contract.family_raw: same frozen train SR per-feature statistics; max only within predefined physical family; no test fit
score_contract.forest_raw: same pinned StandardIF/ExtendedIF anomaly score; train-only RobustEncoder for each43/2 feature view
score_contract.typed_value: raw_score is dimensionless model/family-specific anomaly score; raw_cut same score unit; prediction strict raw_score>raw_cut; any display margin is labelled separately and is not severity/probability
score_contract.or_ternary: positive if any ready branch positive; negative only if every required branch ready and negative; otherwise unknown
score_contract.validity_bits: metadata gates only for relation2/family; never injected as labels; original full43 numeric flags remain original43 view

budget_policy.cut_candidate_policy: legacy fixed quantile grid plus maximum group/cadence higher quantile floor at 1-allocated-positive-budget; first passing candidate; strict >; all candidates bounded; no holdout recalibration
budget_policy.eligibility: each required group has finite calibration score; training rows>=256 for forest; branch cuts pass allocated guards; actual OR union passes full group/cadence budget; otherwise whole arm ineligible with reason and holdout score NaN
budget_policy.forest_cut_requirement: finite raw_cut < 1 AND raw_cut < U, where U<=1 is a conservative frozen-forest score upper bound from the mean of each tree minimum depth+leaf-size-correction. raw_cut>=U proves strict crossing impossible and makes the arm ineligible; raw_cut<U does not guarantee simultaneous attainable paths.
budget_policy.normal_denominators: prediction-available group hours as legacy evaluation; also report full timeline unknown/coverage and shared-eligible comparisons so relation absence cannot masquerade as lower false alarms

counterfactual_policy.command: separate locked evaluation command; same seed/protocol/RNG; only relation duration reassignment disabled in memory
counterfactual_policy.service_events: actual original20/seed; counterfactual removes only four relation rows =>16/seed
counterfactual_policy.control_windows: four original relation target windows/seed kept separately under same event_id; counterfactual windows are normal for false-alarm/occupancy evaluation
counterfactual_policy.paired_denominators: actual60 service events vs counterfactual48 service events; paired12 relationship controls reported separately; never combine denominators
assertions: duration outside relation targets exact equal
each target hour duration multiset exact equal
event schedule exact equal excluding postintervention marginal hash
counterfactual_policy.normality: controlled synthetic counterfactual, not a fully normal split and not real incident truth
counterfactual_policy.normal_truth_authority: service events passed to normal_statistics; original source normal_confirmed target labels remain untouched and must not filter CF normal evaluation

freeze_policy.main_blind_open: root GO only after code/protocol/train references/models/calibration cuts/eligibility artifact SHA frozen; runner must validate lock then explicitly allow_main_blind
freeze_policy.source_manifest: store source SHA, protocol SHA, seeds, scored start/end, source rows, event/control counts, pinned legacy source SHA; declare source synthetic and real_source_used false

source_contract.count_expected_activity: every source-bin frozen count q05>0; inactive or uncertain low-volume references unsupported for early recovery
source_contract.count_quiet: all recent source bins within each source-bin frozen q05/q95 inclusive
source_contract.latency_quiet: all recent bins have observed duration,count>0 and duration within source-bin frozen q05/q95 inclusive
source_contract.source_strong: current included 1m bin outside frozen q01/q99 strictly; direction -1/+1; policy counts same-direction3 consecutive minutes
source_contract.relation_quiet: rolling corr/residual frozen SR deviation max<=1
source_contract.relation_strong: same recent deviation > passed frozen SR relation active_cut; policy counts3 consecutive minutes
source_contract.quantile_policy: np.quantile(frozen training table values,q,method=linear); new recovery-policy thresholds, not refit of model/reference or recalibration of model cuts
source_contract.unsupported: quiet/strong false, reason kept; policy releases suppression and falls back to original ready raw output; do not change original support denominator
source_contract.baseline_unknown: original unknown output and reset all policy state; raw-ready/evidence-unsupported resets suppression and falls back to original raw output

development.source_reproduction: previous blind now development only; require caller-provided original source SHA for reproduction checks

final.open_condition: explicit root GO only after protocol/source/policy candidate freeze; no fresh final generation in development

fixture.source_period: original May train/cal and July blind, exact source manifest hashes required

evaluation.recovery_truth: generator intervention end per type, labels for evaluation only; never read event/recovery labels in signals
evaluation.normal_time: recovered event time remains in normal positive-time denominator; no ringdown exemption
evaluation.raw_preservation: keep original W1 raw/cut/raw-positive; recovery is alarm-output postprocessing
evaluation.detection: paired original event hit losses and delay; false-clear during active intervention; recurrence/rearm miss and delay; source/evidence/policy support reported separately
evaluation.counterfactual: same RNG disables only relation reassignment; other48 interventions unchanged; relation controls are normal for FP/occupancy
evaluation.decision_clock: Accumulate evidence at1m; only use baseline model outputs issued at native C5/C1 decision ticks. Do not use unissued off-grid ML scores. Raw/unknown support and original candidate eligibility remain unchanged.

policy_calibration_eligibility.source: reuse original frozen normal-calibration source/raw/cuts, no model fit or raw-cut recalibration
policy_calibration_eligibility.policy_failure: freeze policy_cal_eligible=False with group/cadence/reason; candidate cannot be adopted, but preserve its actual alarm output and diagnostic metrics; never replace with NaN solely for policy-calibration failure
policy_calibration_eligibility.mask_contract: policy calibration failure must not change original finite/unknown masks
policy_calibration_eligibility.no_posthoc_relaxation: no cut relaxation, replacement candidate, or retry selection after observing final outcomes

evaluation.recovery_censoring: No detected alarm implies recovery delay null with censoring/reason, never0; retain unresolved and unknown intervals separately.

limits: No actual service generalization or operating eligibility promise
30pairs and overlapping evidence are not iid confidence guarantees
full43 ML type attribution undefined; typed recovery must be explicit

model_policy.normal_calibration_replay: evaluate fixed policies/cuts only; preserve original ineligibility; never retune cuts
model_policy.ml2_recovery_proxy: use same frozen SR relation statistics and the corresponding joint1/6 SR relation active_cut, not ML raw-score units

timing_contract.quiet: The first issued raw-positive tick t0 is emitted positive immediately. If its evidence is quiet, set quiet_since=t0 on that same tick; clear no earlier than t0+10min with every intermediate1m sample quiet (11 consecutive timestamps). C5 example t0 positive then first possible clear at t0+10, not t0+15. Unsupported/neutral interruptions reset the quiet streak.
timing_contract.strong: three same-direction consecutive observed1m evidence bins; policy owns this counter, no extra window in signals
timing_contract.neutral: reset quiet/strong streaks; preserve current unsuppressed/suppressed mode until strong or raw reset
timing_contract.unsupported_evidence: reset suppression latch and both counters; fall back to ready raw output without support-mask change
timing_contract.baseline_negative_or_unknown: reset policy state; output unchanged original negative/unknown
timing_contract.native_decisions: 1m evidence may accumulate continuously; original raw/model states enter policy only on native C5/C1 issued ticks; no off-grid model scores
